title: DITO Gaming Modem: who is it for?

blocks.text: The DITO Gaming Modem is a peculiar device. Behind the Team Liquid partnership and branding, the device is essentially a 5G wireless modem with one RJ45 LAN port.

Because it runs on a 5G DITO SIM card, it’s portable and plug and play. It also goes without saying that this device works best in areas where DITO’s 5G signal is strong. Out of the box, you have the actual unit, a wall plug, and a CAT 6 LAN cable. The modem itself is pretty much up to date, with support for WiFi 6 and up to 500 Mbps of speeds. Indoors, I was able to get 100 Mbps on wireless. I moved the modem to an area with fewer walls and closer to the window and got 250 Mbps of speed.

Compared to the DITO WoWFi bundle, the gaming modem sets itself apart by having some on-device and DITO network tweaks to prioritize gaming experiences to persist In the admin settings I was able to see over 40 games supported by these tweaks, giving network priority
The DITO Gaming Modem is for you if:

items: You have no reliable wired Internet service available in your area, and if your 5G signal is good. DITO has constantly made strides in 5G coverage across the Metro. One thing to note is that DITO makes use of 5G SA or a “standalone” system that was not upgraded from any legacy system compared to SMART and Globe (the days of 2G, 3G, 4G, etc). This means that their technology is pure 5G data – it does not have the baggage of legacy systems so their 5G quality is above par.

You are more focused on gaming and share Internet with other people at home. The DITO Gaming Modem’s Gaming Boost mode prioritizes games that have been deemed compatible (from the admin settings), over other Internet traffic. These include favorites like Roblox, Valorant, and more (as I said, there’s over 40 supported modern games).

Your home mesh network setup has a gaming rig that is far from a wired connection. At our home we have one desktop that is located near the window, but far from a wired connection. For online classes and regular browsing, it’s fine on the mesh network. But for games, it can experience latency. The DITO Gaming Modem is perfect for this setup because I was able to set up the modem beside the window, and plugged into the desktop via LAN.

blocks.text: The DITO Gaming Modem is available at a discounted price of P6,990 from an original price of P8,990. It comes with 250 pesos worth of Steam credits once you activate the SIM card. The Gaming Modem comes with unli-5G access for the first 15 days.
